title: Replace your AI tab collection with one of these smarter, multi-model options
excerpt: Put multiple AI models to work.
content_html:
TL;DR: Amp up your AI workflow with one of these AI toolkits that give you access to multiple AI models: ChatPlayground compares models, 1min.AI handles broad creative work, and ChatOn offers everyday AI assistance across devices.

Credit: ChatOn

$59.97
$619 Save $559.03

We use AI in almost everything now, from writing and research to design, coding, and planning. Using a single AI model is sort of like using the hunt-and-peck method to type. It can get the job done, but you won’t be doing it as efficiently or as wisely as you can.

Multi-model tools are the new way to do AI business and make it all easier to manage by bringing several assistants and specialized features into one workspace. No need for multiple subscriptions or running the same prompt a million times. It also means you don’t have to pay for multiple AI models. The smart pick depends on what you need to accomplish.

Here are three top-tier AI tools to help you decide which might be best for you.

Compare answers with ChatPlayground AI

ChatPlayground is built for people who want to compare before committing to an answer. Enter one prompt and review results from 20+ models, including ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, and Perplexity. It also supports coding, prompt refinement, image generation, image and PDF chats, saved history, and priority support. Unlimited monthly messages are subject to fair use, and available models may change as the platform evolves.

Get lifetime ChatPlayground AI Unlimited access on sale for just $59.97 (reg. $619) through Aug. 25.

Create across formats with 1min.AI

1min.AI is the broad content-production option. Its assistants span OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral AI, and Cohere. Tools cover writing, keyword research, image creation and editing, multi-document chats, translation, presentations, and PDF questions. Audio features include transcription, speech generation, music, voice tools, isolation, and translation.

Includes 1,000,000 credits per month, plus the opportunity to generate up to 450,000 additional credits every month.

Get lifetime 1min.AI access for just $39.99 (reg. $234).

Handle everyday tasks with ChatOn’s mobile app

ChatOn suits everyday work across iOS, Android, and the web. New users get GPT, Gemini, Claude, Sonar, 100+ prepared prompts, voice input, document processing, OCR, image and video creation, and real-time web search with source links. Its AI keyboard can also generate text inside other apps.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get one year of ChatOn Premium for a one-time $29.99 (reg. $39.99), for new users only.

The right tool depends on how you work. Pick the one that solves your biggest workflow bottleneck and put AI to better use.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
